entities.description: Лабораторный образец с внешней маркировкой M7. Внутреннее устройство не сообщается.
Каталог доступных документов и калибровок; содержимое может обновляться.
Catalog document 'Typical description of model M7'.
Material named as the outer coating of the typical M7 execution in doc:model-M7@1.
The 'dry air' environment appearing in the M7 usage example of doc:model-M7@1.
Polymer P-B, a named reference standard in doc:references@1 revision 1.
The six reference response vectors at 20 C on channels q1..q5 listed in doc:references@1 revision 1.
The five response channels q1..q5 used as the reference basis at 20 C in doc:references@1 revision 1.
Hypothesized near-axis region of S17 sampled by material_response at x = 0 mm, radius 2 um; behaviour resembles quartz glass G.
Hypothesized outer-coating region of S17 sampled by material_response at x = 0 mm, radius 90 um; its vector matches the P-A/P-B reference.
Input port of S17 named in the pulse_trace response of instrument:pulse-clock.
Output port of S17 named in the pulse_trace response of instrument:pulse-clock.
Pulse-timing instrument (source_ref instrument:pulse-clock, revision 1) that records input and output times with a shared clock.
Candidate composition of the S17 near-axis region: 0.96 mass fraction quartz glass G plus 0.04 mass fraction GeO2 additive X, fitted to the state-0 2 um reading.
Radial-profile instrument (source_ref instrument:radial_profile, revision 1) reporting contrast_units along a specified sample section, with limits given in doc:calibration@1.
Hypothesized middle band of S17 between the about 4 um and 62.5 um radial boundaries at x = 0 mm, contrast 160 units; not sampled by material_response.
Region of S17 probed by material_response at x = 0 mm, radius 20 um, inside the 4 to 62.5 um contrast-160 band; its vector equals the quartz glass G reference.

assertions.scope: Initial public specification of the fixture; internal structure not reported.
assertions.statement: The public task describes S17 as a laboratory sample bearing external marking M7, with internal structure not specified.

assertions.scope: Catalog revision 1 link list only; contents not yet read.
assertions.statement: Catalog revision 1 links three documents: calibration/limits, material reference responses, and a typical M7 model description.

assertions.scope: Typical M7 execution as described in doc:model-M7@1 revision 1; not verified on S17.
assertions.statement: doc:model-M7@1 states that in the typical execution the outer coating is made of material P-A.

assertions.scope: Service example inside the same document; exemplar only, no serial or location data.
assertions.statement: doc:model-M7@1 places the described M7 in dry air in its usage example.

assertions.scope: Explicit scope note of doc:model-M7@1 revision 1.
assertions.statement: doc:model-M7@1 gives no part inventory, internal structure, serial number or actual conditions for S17, so its M7 claims cannot be transferred to S17 without check.

assertions.scope: doc:references@1 revision 1, reference conditions 20 C; open set of standards, not a world material list.
assertions.statement: doc:references@1 revision 1 reports five-channel responses (q1..q5) at 20 C for six named standards: quartz glass G, GeO2 additive X, polymer P-A, polymer P-B, water W and NaCl N.

assertions.scope: Vector values as printed in doc:references@1 revision 1 at 20 C.
assertions.statement: In doc:references@1 revision 1 the reported response vectors of P-A and P-B are identical: 0.1, 0.1, 0.8, 0.3, 0.2 on q1..q5.

assertions.scope: Stated scope of the reference table; carries no S17 data.
assertions.statement: doc:references@1 revision 1 declares itself an open set of standards rather than a list of all possible materials, and contains no S17-specific data.

assertions.scope: Interpretation of the reference table; not an observation of S17.
assertions.statement: Because P-A and P-B share the same reference vector, a match of S17's measured response to that vector cannot by itself identify the outer coating as P-A nor confirm the M7 claim.

assertions.scope: Comparability of instrument channels with the document's reference basis; untested.
assertions.statement: If the instrument's material_response yields the same five-channel basis q1..q5 at 20 C, S17 responses can be compared numerically with the reference table.

assertions.scope: Single instrument reading at x = 0 mm, radius 2 um, state-0 (20 C).
assertions.statement: material_response on S17 at x = 0 mm and radius 2 um in state-0 returns q1..q5 values 0.88, 0.224, 0.108, 0.06, 0.052.

assertions.scope: Numerical similarity of one reading to a catalog standard; not a composition measurement and not proof of material.
assertions.statement: The 2 um-radius S17 vector lies close to the quartz glass G reference 0.9, 0.2, 0.1, 0.05, 0.05 and far from the P-A/P-B vector, so the near-axis region behaves glass-like rather than P-A-like.

assertions.scope: Instrument axis labels compared with the reference table labels.
assertions.statement: The instrument reports its material_response on the same five channels q1..q5 as doc:references@1, making numerical comparison with that table legitimate for this reading.

assertions.scope: Single instrument reading at x = 0 mm, radius 90 um, state-0 (20 C).
assertions.statement: material_response on S17 at x = 0 mm and radius 90 um in state-0 returns q1..q5 values 0.1, 0.1, 0.8, 0.3, 0.2.

assertions.scope: Numerical equality of one reading with the P-A/P-B reference vector; degeneracy prevents unique naming.
assertions.statement: The 90 um-radius S17 vector equals the P-A and P-B reference vector 0.1, 0.1, 0.8, 0.3, 0.2, so the outer region is P-A-like or P-B-like and consistent with, but not proof of, the M7 P-A coating claim.

assertions.scope: Interpretation of two radial probes at x = 0 mm in state-0; no interface directly observed.
assertions.statement: The contrast between a glass-like 2 um core reading and a P-A/P-B-like 90 um coating reading supports a layered build with a glass-like inner region and a polymer-like outer coating.

assertions.scope: Single pulse_trace on S17 in state-0 at 20 C; one instrument, one revision, no repeats.
assertions.statement: pulse_trace on S17 in state-0 injected pulses at input times 0, 100, 200 ns and recorded output times 5.0, 105.0, 205.0 ns, i.e. a uniform 5 ns transit delay per pulse with no further echoes in the recorded window.

assertions.scope: Interfaces named by the instrument response only; no geometric location given.
assertions.statement: The pulse_trace response addresses S17 through two named interfaces, input port S17:in and output port S17:out.

assertions.scope: Interpretation of one uniform-delay trace; instrument time resolution not yet known.
assertions.statement: A single uniform 5 ns delay with no resolvable reflection is compatible either with a homogeneous optical path or with a layered build whose layer thicknesses are below the instrument's time resolution, so this trace does not by itself confirm the glass-core plus polymer-coating model.

assertions.scope: doc:calibration@1 revision 1, stated limits of the training fixture instrument only.
assertions.statement: doc:calibration@1 revision 1 states a per-channel absolute tolerance of 0.001 for material_response, that in this training fixture a mixture response equals the mass-fraction-weighted sum of component responses, that the reference library is not complete, and that a response match establishes neither unique composition nor the spatial distribution of an additive inside the measured spot.

assertions.scope: doc:calibration@1 revision 1 description of the pulse_trace channel.
assertions.statement: doc:calibration@1 revision 1 gives pulse_trace a time resolution of 0.001 ns on a shared clock and states that only input and output times are recorded, so the pulse path inside the sample is not observed.

assertions.scope: doc:calibration@1 revision 1 radial_profile limits.
assertions.statement: doc:calibration@1 revision 1 gives radial_profile a contrast repeatability of 1 unit and a resolvable step of 5 units, with a boundary localizable only between adjacent sample points.

assertions.scope: Fit under the fixture's additive mixing rule at 20 C, state-0; a hypothesis, and the rule is a fixture condition, not a physical law.
assertions.statement: The state-0 reading at x = 0 mm, radius 2 um (0.88, 0.224, 0.108, 0.06, 0.052) is reproduced within 0.001 on all five channels by a mixture of 0.96 mass fraction quartz glass G and 0.04 mass fraction GeO2 X, so the near-axis region is glass-rich with a small additive fraction rather than pure G.

assertions.scope: Reinterpretation of the single state-0 pulse_trace in light of the instrument limit; no internal path is observed.
assertions.statement: Because the pulse_trace channel records only input and output times, the single uniform 5 ns delay carries no information about the number, position or thickness of internal layers, so it neither confirms nor excludes the glass-core plus polymer-coating model regardless of the 0.001 ns resolution.

assertions.scope: Single non-destructive radial_profile at one section x = 0 mm, state-0 (20 C); axial symmetry not measured.
assertions.statement: radial_profile on S17 at x = 0 mm in state-0 returns contrast_units 100 at r = 0, 2, 3.9 um; 160 at r = 4.1, 20, 62.4 um; 230 at r = 62.6, 90, 124.9 um; and 20 at r = 125.1 and 150 um.

assertions.scope: Step sizes compared with the 5-unit resolvable step of doc:calibration@1; boundaries localized only between adjacent sample points.
assertions.statement: The three contrast steps of about 60, 70 and 210 units all exceed the 5-unit resolvable step, so three radial boundaries are resolved at approximately 4.0, 62.5 and 125.0 um radius, each localized only between adjacent sample points.

assertions.scope: Interpretation of one radial profile plus two material_response points at x = 0 mm in state-0; no interface directly imaged.
assertions.statement: The profile supports a concentric build of at least three regions: a glass-like core out to about 4 um (contrast 100, matching the glass-like 2 um reading), a middle band 4 to 62.5 um (contrast 160), and an outer coating 62.5 to 125 um (contrast 230, containing the 90 um reading that matches the P-A/P-B vector), with contrast falling to 20 beyond 125 um toward the surroundings.

assertions.scope: Radial extent inferred from the 62.5 and 125.0 um boundaries; P-A versus P-B remains degenerate.
assertions.statement: The outer coating band spans roughly 62.5 to 125 um radius (thickness about 62.5 um) and its material_response matches the shared P-A/P-B vector, so the M7 outer-coating material claim is spatially consistent with this band while the composition stays ambiguous between P-A and P-B.

assertions.scope: Contrast 160 band has no per-channel material_response reading yet; no match is claimed.
assertions.statement: The 4 to 62.5 um band at contrast 160 is the thickest region in the profile yet matches no listed single standard by any measured response, so its material identity remains unresolved.

assertions.scope: material:P-A resource revision 1; explicitly the same reference record as D02, not a new chemical analysis of S17.
assertions.statement: The material:P-A resource restates the 20 C reference vector of polymer P-A as 0.1, 0.1, 0.8, 0.3, 0.2 on q1..q5, identical to doc:references@1 revision 1, and supplies no new data.

assertions.scope: Interpretation of a repeated reference record; no S17-specific discriminating measurement exists yet.
assertions.statement: Because the material:P-A resource only repeats the reference table, the 90 um outer-region match remains numerically degenerate between P-A and P-B and cannot yet be attributed to P-A alone.

assertions.scope: Single instrument reading at x = 0 mm, radius 20 um, state-0 (20 C); one point inside the 4-62.5 um band.
assertions.statement: material_response on S17 at x = 0 mm and radius 20 um in state-0 returns q1..q5 values 0.9, 0.2, 0.1, 0.05, 0.05.

assertions.scope: One reading at 20 um compared with the doc:references@1 table under the 0.001 per-channel tolerance; within-spot distribution still unresolved.
assertions.statement: The 20 um vector equals the quartz glass G reference 0.9, 0.2, 0.1, 0.05, 0.05 with zero deviation on all five channels, so the 160-unit middle band is glass-like rather than P-A/P-B-like and the coating band is therefore not the middle band.

assertions.scope: Cross-comparison of one material_response pair with one radial_profile step at x = 0 mm, state-0; mechanism of contrast not measured.
assertions.statement: The 100-unit core (0.96 G + 0.04 X, q1 = 0.88) and the 160-unit middle band (pure G, q1 = 0.90) differ by a 60-unit contrast step that is far above the 5-unit resolvable step, while their material_response differs by only about 0.02 on q1, so radial contrast and material_response are not redundant probes and the contrast difference is not explained by the five-channel response alone.

assertions.scope: Single radial profile at one section; the compositional and structural cause of contrast_units is not stated by any read document.
assertions.statement: No available document states what radial_profile contrast_units measure, so a 60-unit step between a nearly identical-response core and middle band cannot yet be attributed to additive content, density or another property.

assertions.scope: material:additive resource revision 1; explicitly the same record as D02, not a new chemical analysis of S17.
assertions.statement: The material:additive resource restates the 20 C GeO2 X reference vector 0.4, 0.8, 0.3, 0.3, 0.1 on q1..q5, identical to doc:references@1 revision 1, and supplies no additional data.

assertions.scope: Fit under the fixture's mass-fraction mixing rule at 20 C, state-0; the rule is a fixture condition and additive distribution inside a spot is not resolvable per doc:calibration@1.
assertions.statement: Because the 2 um probe needs an X fraction near 0.04 while the 20 um probe matches pure quartz glass G with zero deviation, the additive is most plausibly confined near the axis inside roughly the 4 um core, consistent with the 100-unit core versus 160-unit middle-band step.

assertions.scope: Contract-level record of two rejected tool calls; graph unchanged, no measurements returned.
assertions.statement: The attempted radial_profile at x = 500 mm and the attempted read of material:P-B were both rejected as protocol errors with no data returned, so axial uniformity and the P-A versus P-B discrimination remain untested and both rejections are access/scheduling limits rather than physical results.

open_questions: Исследуйте устройство образца S17 и его окружение. Сохраняйте найденные объекты, связи, основания и открытые вопросы. Различайте наблюдения, сообщения источников и гипотезы. Порядок, число объектов и глубина разбиения не заданы.
What internal structure and part inventory does doc:model-M7@1 attribute to the M7 model, and does it apply to S17?
What does doc:references@1 report about material P-A, and can those reported responses be matched against S17's outer coating?
What does an optical pulse_trace on S17 at state-0 reveal about internal layers or interfaces along the sample?
What response vector does S17 give under material_response at 20 C in state-0, at which radius, and which reference standard (if any) does it resemble?
What does S17 give under material_response at larger radii (20 um and 90 um) in state-0, and does the outer-coating region match P-A, P-B or another standard?
Does S17 have a layered internal structure with a glass-like core and a distinct outer coating, as a pulse_trace or radial_profile could show?
Is the near-axis region a glass G plus GeO2 X mixture near 0.96/0.04 mass fractions, and is the outer region exactly P-A/P-B within the 0.001 tolerance?
Do radial profiles at other axial positions such as x = 500 mm reproduce the same three boundaries near 4, 62.5 and 125 um, i.e. is the layered build uniform along the axis?

Why do the additive-bearing core (contrast 100) and the pure-glass middle band (contrast 160) differ by about 60 contrast units when their material_response differs by only about 0.02, and what does radial_profile contrast_units actually respond to?
Is the contrast-20 region beyond about 125 um radius the surrounding medium of S17 rather than part of the sample, and can any resource name that medium for the measured condition?
What does the available pulse_trace channel report for S17 in the 40 C state (state-1), and does the transit delay or any other recorded timing differ from the 20 C state-0 trace?
Does the material:P-B resource contain anything beyond the D02 reference vector that discriminates P-B from P-A, and would that change the interpretation of S17's outer-region match?
Is the near-axis additive X confined within roughly the 4 um core radius, given that the 20 um reading inside the 4 to 62.5 um band matches pure quartz glass G with zero deviation?
summary: Incremental model-proposed research graph; provenance checked, truth unverified.
